Telephone Manager Initialization Functions

Initializing the Telephone Manager

This section describes the functions you use to initialize the Telephone Manager. It also describes the function you use to determine which version of the Telephone Manager is running on the system. By checking the version of Telephone Manger, you can ensure that it supports all of the features implemented in your application.
